description: Four slots beside every remixable image block, always shown: an empty slot is the example roundel, very transparent, marking where the visitor's swatch (made in the range, max four) will land; a made swatch replaces its placeholder in position. Tapping a swatch remixes the block's own image into the block's own room type — the wardrobes feature a bedroom, the media feature a living room, each card its room — true to the scheme, the rest of the room complementing it (the render route's remix mode). One dismissible call-out per block; dismissing one dismisses all and shows the reminder toast.
